jobs.title: Call for Applicants: Advisory Committee — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for "experts" to join an advisory committee, not a paid entry-level role — it seeks established specialists with a track record protecting defenders across specific regions, which the candidate lacks, and it is not a genuine salaried vacancy. The human-rights/securitisation subject is genuinely interesting, but the advisory-expert framing is a hard mismatch for an early-career applicant.

jobs.title: Policy Fellow or Senior Policy Fellow, US Development Policy Program
jobs.reason: Location is a hard filter (London only) and this role is based in Washington, DC with no London option. It is also a Fellow / Senior Fellow role well above entry level.

jobs.title: Fellow, Climate policy & development
jobs.reason: A "Fellow" role at a think-tank is a senior, experienced research position well above entry level, requiring an established policy track record the candidate lacks. The climate-development topic also sits outside the candidate's core interest zones.

jobs.title: Lead Auditor
jobs.reason: The "Lead" title signals a non-entry-level role, and it requires ISO-standards auditing qualifications and technical experience the candidate does not have. It is also entirely outside the candidate's research, policy and intelligence interest areas.

jobs.title: Strategic Accounts Manager
jobs.reason: Requires 7+ years of enterprise B2B sales experience, a senior "Manager" title, and a proven sales/quota track record — well beyond entry-level and a hard disqualifier. It is also a cybersecurity sales role with no fit to the candidate's research and policy background or interests.

jobs.title: Lead Assessor, Responsible Sourcing
jobs.reason: "Lead" title plus essential requirements of minimum two years of social-compliance auditing, 100+ verifiable audit days, APSCA/CSCA registration and fluent English AND Spanish — none of which the candidate holds. The Spanish-fluency essential and the specialist auditing credentials are hard disqualifiers, and the topic is only tangential to the candidate's core interests.

jobs.title: Surveyor Center
jobs.reason: Requires an engineering / materials-science degree and 5–6 years of professional experience — both essential requirements the candidate plainly lacks. It is a technical inspection/surveyor role with no connection to the candidate's research or policy profile.

jobs.title: Contractor on Demand (Lead auditor Cyber - ISO 27001)
jobs.reason: This role requires ISO 27001 lead-auditor qualification and cyber-audit competencies the candidate does not hold, and the "Lead auditor" level with professional certification is a hard mismatch for an early-career researcher. It is also entirely outside the candidate's interest zones and skill set.

jobs.title: ECD Assessor
jobs.reason: This is a technical industrial-inspection role requiring specialist certifications (PED Module H, ISO 3834-2 welding assessment) the candidate does not hold and could not quickly acquire. It is entirely outside the candidate's research/policy profile and interest zones, and the essential technical qualifications are unmet.

jobs.title: Advisory Committee Member — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for expert Advisory Committee members, not a paid entry-level role — it seeks established experts to advise the project, which the candidate (a student without professional expertise) does not qualify as, and it appears to be a voluntary/speculative advisory position rather than a concrete paid vacancy. The human-rights subject is interesting, but the seniority/expert framing and lack of a paid role gate it out.

jobs.title: Security Consultant - Governance Risk Compliance
jobs.reason: This is a technical cybersecurity GRC consulting role requiring practical experience delivering GRC engagements, working knowledge of IT/OT/ICS security, networking and operating systems — a substantial technical skills gap the candidate's analysis-level Python and non-technical profile cannot meet. The role also requires residence in Singapore and is a consultant-level position expecting independent engagement delivery, none of which fits the candidate's academic international-law and policy background.

jobs.title: OSINT Investigator - Contractor - Arabic speaker - Sudan
jobs.reason: Ineligible: Arabic at C1/Professional level is an essential requirement the candidate does not meet (working languages are German/English, French only B1). The role also requires a proven OSINT investigation track record the candidate lacks. Although CIR and atrocity documentation are a perfect interest match, the language and experience essentials are hard blockers.

jobs.title: Product and Delivery Manager, Centre for Collective Intelligence
jobs.reason: This is a "Manager" role with essential requirements for a track record of owning a digital product end-to-end, agile product management, and leading products through scaling — clearly not entry-level and beyond the candidate's student-assistant experience. The digital-participation subject is mildly adjacent, but the seniority and product-management essentials are hard mismatches.

jobs.title: Community Network Manager
jobs.reason: A "Manager" title signals a non-entry-level role, which is a hard disqualifier for a candidate with no full-time professional experience. The public-law / legal-charity context is adjacent to the candidate's interests, but the seniority level is a hard mismatch.

jobs.title: Warehouse Assistant
jobs.reason: This is a manual warehouse / logistics role requiring physical handling and stock-control experience — a complete mismatch for an academic-research profile, though nothing in it triggers a hard disqualifier (it is a paid, non-managerial role with only a soft 1–2 year ask). It sits entirely outside all three interest zones and offers no paper-fit alignment, so it barely warrants surfacing.
